method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: OpenAI annualised revenues $20bn less than previously signalled
Equities.summary: AI group recently told investors the critical figure was nearing $50bn in September, far less than the $70bn widely reported
Equities.reason: Material downward revision to the revenue outlook for a dominant AI provider weakens the AI-led growth narrative that has been propping up mega-cap tech; this is a significant negative signal for broad equity risk appetite and AI leadership stocks.

Equities.title: Nasdaq 100 Drops 1.4% as OpenAI Warning Deepens Bubble Fears
Equities.reason: Sharp move lower in the Nasdaq 100 tied to an OpenAI revenue warning highlights concentrated downside risk in AI/semis leadership; this represents sizeable market impact and reinforces a risk-off tilt.

Equities.title: AI Debt Spree Hammers Tech Debt as Traders Rush to Reprice Risk
Equities.reason: Credit-market repricing for AI/tech borrowers signals liquidity and funding stress feeding into equity valuations; this is a broad negative for risk assets and increases the chance of further equity weakness.

Equities.title: Tech stocks struggle on AI spending worries, elevated yields
Equities.reason: Combination of AI spending concerns and higher yields is undermining growth/long-duration tech multiples — a negative for equity risk sentiment and the leadership that has driven markets.

Equities.title: Wall St turns lower as crude spikes, chip stocks weigh
Equities.reason: Rising oil and yields are weighing on sentiment and increasing uncertainty for equities; this is a moderating negative for market breadth beyond tech.

Equities.title: Nvidia-backed Aussie AI firm Firmus withdraws historic IPO, citing market volatility
Equities.summary: Nvidia-backed Australian AI data center operator Firmus has withdrawn its planned IPO amid market volatility.
Equities.reason: A high-profile IPO withdrawal in the AI/data-center space highlights risk aversion in the new-issue market and reduces investor appetite for growth listings — a sectoral negative with spillovers to sentiment.

Equities.title: Five ways to tell if market trouble lies ahead
Equities.summary: The cost of credit default swaps for AI companies looking to borrow is rising
Equities.reason: Rising CDS costs for AI firms are an early-warning credit signal that financing risk is increasing for leading growth companies; this supports a cautious / negative equity market narrative.

Rates.title: Treasury yields are lower after reaching multiyear highs, traders weigh latest bond auction
Rates.summary: Traders digested comments from a top Federal Reserve official while awaiting another long-dated bond auction.
Rates.reason: Article reports yields easing after recent multiyear highs and ahead of an auction — a near-term bond rally/receipt of confidence narrative (yields down = positive for Rates). High relevance given market-moving auction and Fed commentary.

Rates.title: Options traders start calling bottom on bond rout after 'bullet bid' 10-year auction
Rates.summary: Calling a bottom in the nonstop U.S. Treasury bond sell-off might seem crazy, but a handful of options traders look increasingly willing to do it.
Rates.reason: Shows market participants seeing a potential floor after recent selloff — supports a bond-improvement narrative (positive for Rates). Options activity gives market-structure signal but narrower audience, hence moderate relevance.

Rates.title: Longer-Dated US Bonds Rise Ahead of $22 Billion 30-Year Sale
Rates.reason: Reports longer-dated Treasuries rallying into a large 30-year sale — direct bond-market action consistent with yields pulling back (positive for Rates).

Rates.title: Bond yields fall as Treasury market passes a crucial test of investor confidence
Rates.reason: Frames recent auction/market action as a confidence test that resulted in yields falling — strong confirmation of a reprieve in the bond rout (high relevance for Rates).

Rates.title: US 10-year Treasury yields risk hitting 6% for first time since 2000, Pimco says
Rates.summary: Bond giant’s investment chief warns that further sharp rise in borrowing costs is ‘feasible’ as market participants are forced to unwind losing bets
Rates.reason: Prominent house (Pimco) warns of materially higher long-term yields — a significant downside risk to bonds (yields up = negative for Rates). High relevance given firm's market influence and explicit large-yield scenario.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, September 15-16, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, September 15-16, 2026
Rates.reason: FOMC minutes provide policy-maker views that drive rate expectations. Treated as a modestly negative signal here (minutes likely underscore cautious/hawkish language that keeps rate risk tilted higher), so included as a counter-signal with moderate relevance.

Rates.title: Why the Battered Bond Market is Finally Getting a Reprieve
Rates.reason: Narrative piece describing the market turning lower in yields and reasons for a reprieve — supports the prevailing bond-rally / correction story (positive for Rates).

Rates.title: Chinese Bonds Become Source of Cheap Money for Global Borrowers
Rates.reason: Reports global borrowers tapping cheap Chinese bond markets — can ease global funding pressure and be modestly supportive for global sovereign yields (slight positive for Rates), but indirect so lower relevance.

Rates.title: US 30-year fixed-rate mortgage rate hits 7.40%, likely to further erode housing demand
Rates.reason: Mortgage rates at multiyear highs reflect elevated long-term yields and economic transmission — a negative indicator for bond prices (yields high = negative for Rates), but this is a derivative/sector signal so lower relevance.

FX.title: British Pound: Resilient growth supports more BoE hikes - Commerzbank
FX.summary: Volkmar Baur at Commerzbank highlights the UK economy’s resilient growth, with upward revisions to GDP and solid monthly data. With inflation still sticky and core inflation at 2.6%, he now expects the Bank of England to hike rates in November and again in Feb
FX.reason: Clear BoE hiking expectations are a USD-negative/GBP-positive driver. Central-bank guidance on further hikes is high-impact for GBP/USD and broad FX positioning, elevating relevance.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar strengthens as risk-on mood weighs on US Dollar
FX.summary: USD/CAD extends its losses for the second successive day, trading around 1.4210 during Asian hours on Friday.
FX.reason: Direct USD/CAD move: risk-on sentiment and USD softness support CAD. Straight USD-centric FX flow with clear transmission into CAD makes this a relevant FX item.

FX.title: Australian Dollar slides as AI sell-off rattles Wall Street
FX.summary: The Aussie Dollar dives 0.11% on Thursday as the US Dollar retreats from monthly highs, with safe-haven flows shifting from the Greenback to the Japanese Yen and the Swiss Franc amid losses on Wall Street and US yields. The AUD/USD trades at 0.6960 at the time
FX.reason: Risk-off stemming from an AI-sector sell-off hit risk-sensitive AUD. The piece links equity/sector stress to FX flows, making it relevant; it points to AUD downside amid safe-haven flows.

FX.title: Yen gains as Trump rules out Iran strikes before the midterms
FX.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield ended near 5.22% after President Trump said on Truth Social that the US won't attack Iran before the midterm elections. It had touched its highest since 2002 on Wednesday.
FX.reason: Geopolitical de-escalation and the knee-jerk drop in U.S. yields are supportive for JPY (and other safe-havens) vs USD. Yield-driven USD/JPY dynamics make this an FX-relevant, higher-relevance item.

FX.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Holds gains near 1.1230 on softer USD; bearish bias persists
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair attracts buyers for the second straight day, rising to the 1.1225-1.1230 area during the Asian session on Friday amid a weak US Dollar (USD). Spot prices, however, remain confined within a range held since the beginning of this month, warranti
FX.reason: Technical/price-forecast piece: signals modest EUR strength on softer USD. Per rules, technical/forecast articles get limited relevance despite USD context.

FX.title: British Pound edges higher to near 1.3250, renewed UK fiscal concerns in focus
FX.summary: The GBP/USD pair gathers strength to around 1.3240 during the early Asian trading hours on Friday. The US Dollar (USD) softens against the British Pound (GBP) following comments from Federal Reserve (Fed) Governor Christopher Waller.
FX.reason: GBP strength linked to USD softness after Fed commentary. Reinforces the broader FX narrative of BoE/UK-driven GBP support amid USD moves—clear USD-centric transmission.

FX.title: Pound holds its floor as BoE member Greene presses for a hike
FX.summary: Bank of England (BoE) external member Greene said in Cape Town that it's dangerous to assume markets will do the BoE's work for it, and that UK pay awards look set for about 3.5% next year. She has voted for a hike at each of the last three meetings.
FX.reason: BoE internal hawkish signalling supports GBP vs USD. Multiple BoE hawkish stories reinforce a dominant GBP strength narrative; relevance elevated but not maximum as it's a single-voter comment.

FX.title: Euro holds gains above 1.1200 despite France's fiscal worries
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair holds positive ground near 1.1215 during the early Asian trading hours on Friday. Nonetheless, the potential upside for the major pair might be limited amid fears of France’s debt crisis. The Michigan Consumer Sentiment Index data for October
FX.reason: EUR maintaining gains versus USD but capped by France fiscal concerns. Captures the tension between USD softness and EU-specific risks—relevant USD-pair transmission.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD rises above $60.00 as inflation fears ease
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) gains ground after three days of losses, trading around $60.10 per troy ounce during Asian hours on Friday. Non-yielding Silver gains support as a decline in oil prices eases inflationary concerns and Fed rate hike expectations.
Commodities.reason: Short-term silver price/forecast piece tied to easing inflation and lower rate-hike expectations. Price-forecast format limits relevance but still mildly constructive for precious metals.

Commodities.title: Gold hits fresh weekly top, eyes $4,200 as USD weakens further amid softer bond yields
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) gains positive traction for the second straight day on Friday, extending this week's recovery from a two-month low.
Commodities.reason: Gold rally driven by softer USD and lower yields — clear positive for bullion. Reinforces precious-metals bullishness amid macro-driven demand for non-yielding assets.

Commodities.title: Gold rises on softer dollar, easing yields; Fed outlook in focus
Commodities.reason: Authoritative note that weaker USD and easing yields are lifting gold. High relevance — broad macro/liquidity drivers are primary bull case for precious metals.

Commodities.title: Oil prices jump as Iran steps up tanker attacks, hurricane threatens U.S. Gulf production
Commodities.summary: President Donald Trump and his national security team have talked about possibly restarting large-scale U.S. military operations in Iran, according to reports.
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical risk (tanker attacks) plus hurricane threat to Gulf production increases oil risk premium and tightness — strong positive for crude and refined-product prices.

Commodities.title: WTI slips below $90.50 as Trump signals no pre-election strike on Iran
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price declines after posting nearly 2.5% gains in the previous day, trading around $90.30 per barrel during Asian hours on Friday.
Commodities.reason: Political de-escalation comments from U.S. leadership remove near-term tail risk premium, weighing on oil. Relevant short-term counter-signal to geopolitical-driven rallies.

Commodities.title: China set to resume fuel exports in October following brief suspension — Reuters
Commodities.summary: China is set to resume refined fuel exports in October following a temporary suspension during the Golden Week holiday, Reuters reported on Friday. This move aims to help ease tight global diesel, gasoline and jet ‌fuel markets.
Commodities.reason: Resumption of Chinese refined fuel exports should alleviate tightness in diesel/gasoline/jet markets — modest negative for refined-product and crude price pressure.

Commodities.title: Copper Set for Weekly Gain on China’s Return and Supply Concerns
Commodities.reason: China demand returning plus supply concerns support copper fundamentals — clear positive for industrial metals and base-metal risk premium.

Commodities.title: Crude oil prices and refinery margins generally increased throughout the third quarter
Commodities.summary: Petroleum markets in the third quarter of 2026 (3Q26) were characterized by increasing prices for crude oil and petroleum products amid persistent conflict in the Middle East.
Commodities.reason: EIA summary confirms Q3 price/margin strength driven by Middle East conflict — reinforces prevailing oil-tightness narrative and demand for refined-product capacity.

Commodities.title: U.S. natural gas production reached a record high in July 2026
Commodities.summary: U.S. natural gas production hit an all-time high in July 2026, driven primarily by increased output in the Permian Basin, according to our latest Natural Gas Monthly.
Commodities.reason: Record U.S. gas output increases supply and pressure on prices — negative for natural gas fundamentals, particularly U.S.-centric gas markets.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin rebounds to $82,000 as Trump rules out Iran strikes, oil drops
Crypto.reason: Macro de-risking (geopolitics/oil) lifting BTC — direct price-positive crypto flow; moderate relevance as a market move rather than structural change.

Crypto.title: Live updates: XRP ETFs the only ones in green as BTC, ETH, ZEC funds post outflows
Crypto.reason: ETF flow divergence: outflows from BTC/ETH funds are negative for major crypto liquidity and price; XRP flows are niche positive but the net effect is bearish for core markets.

Crypto.title: Solana is about to halve its block times as final 200-millisecond upgrade nears
Crypto.reason: Protocol upgrade improves throughput/UX for Solana — positive for SOL and developer adoption, but single-chain technical news with limited market-wide impact.

Crypto.title: EU securities regulator gives crypto platforms 3 months to remove unauthorized stablecoins
Crypto.reason: Regulatory enforcement targeting stablecoins in the EU is a meaningful negative for liquidity and stablecoin utility in a major jurisdiction — high relevance and downside for crypto markets.

Crypto.title: Securitize brings Apple, Nvidia and Tesla to Solana, with NYSE trading in the works
Crypto.reason: Large-brand tokenization and potential NYSE trading on Solana is a significant institutional/adoption signal for tokenized RWAs — material positive for tokenization narrative and platform demand.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin ETF investors head for the exit, and it's the biggest rush in months
Crypto.reason: Large-scale outflows from Bitcoin ETFs are a direct negative for BTC price and liquidity; significant investor flow dynamic with material market impact.

Crypto.title: Crypto regulatory delay threatens US market leadership, CFTC Chairman Michael Selig warns
Crypto.reason: Senior regulator warning that regulatory inaction risks US leadership underscores policy uncertainty — negative for US-centered crypto adoption and institutional plans.

Crypto.title: Republican megadonors dominate 2026 midterm election as crypto and AI money surges, CNBC analysis finds
Crypto.summary: Fourteen of the 20 biggest donor groups CNBC analyzed are Republican-aligned as crypto, AI and betting money reshapes 2026 midterm spending.
Crypto.reason: Political spending by crypto-aligned donors may influence future policy; included with low relevance — indirect and longer-term impact on the regulatory environment.

Crypto.title: New tech to power bitcoin lending is set to debut with $500 million in commitments
Crypto.reason: Material commitments to bitcoin lending infrastructure increase liquidity and institutional product depth — positive for market functioning and adoption.

Crypto.title: XRP Ledger adds new controls for banks, stablecoins and tokenized funds
Crypto.reason: Protocol-level controls aimed at banks, stablecoins and tokenized funds improve compliance/readiness for institutional use — constructive for institutional adoption of XRP Ledger.

Crypto.title: Ether bets were wiped out at six times bitcoin’s rate in crypto’s $1 billion flush
Crypto.reason: Concentrated liquidations hitting ether much harder than bitcoin amplify downside risk in ETH markets and margin structures — negative for ETH sentiment/liquidity.

Crypto.title: Top Democrat among Senate investigators probes ties between Cantor Fitzgerald, Tether
Crypto.reason: Senate probe into relationships involving Tether raises legal/regulatory risk for the largest stablecoin — a meaningful negative for stablecoin confidence and market plumbing.

Crypto.title: Wall Street's tokenization boom could have bigger winners than bitcoin and ether, Citrini says
Crypto.reason: Industry view that tokenization (RWAs) could outpace base crypto assets highlights positive structural demand for tokenized products and platforms.

Crypto.title: Crypto crumbles as anniversary of flash crash nears
Crypto.reason: Near-term market weakness and volatility ahead of a notable anniversary is a negative for risk sentiment and trading liquidity.

Crypto.title: NFL joins pushback against prediction markets as U.S. Supreme Court asked to act
Crypto.reason: High-profile legal pushback against prediction markets creates regulatory/legal uncertainty for a crypto-native use case; negative but industry-niche.

Crypto.title: U.S. government moves $1 billion in bitcoin tied to Bitfinex hack, with no sign of sale
Crypto.reason: Large on-chain government movement is notable for supply overhang risk, but lack of sale indication mutes immediate market impact — small net negative signal.

Crypto.title: ‘Bunker mode’ is a far greater challenge for institutions than individual crypto holders
Crypto.reason: Institutional operational/security challenges (framed as 'bunker mode') raise barriers to institutional participation and are a modest negative for adoption momentum.

Crypto.title: Over 6 million bitcoin sit behind exposed public keys as AI warnings mount
Crypto.reason: On-chain security exposures amplified by AI-related risks are a direct negative for holder confidence and counterparty risk considerations.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin and ether holders urged to enter ‘bunker mode’ against possible AI attacks
Crypto.reason: Calls for holders to take defensive security measures due to AI threats increase perceived operational risk — negative for market sentiment and liquidity.

Crypto.title: NUVA brings U.S. residential mortgage credit to offshore investors
Crypto.reason: Tokenization of U.S. residential mortgage credit represents RWA distribution to offshore investors — constructive for the tokenization/RWA adoption narrative.

Crypto.title: Standard Chartered to expand institutional crypto and RWA custody to Singapore
Crypto.reason: Major bank expanding institutional custody and RWA services signals stronger institutional infrastructure and geographic adoption — positive for long-term market development.
